[feite] Baie daarvan is prente van mense wat jag en dans. Party pren — corrected: Each sentence is defensible on its own, but together they teach the view researchers have dropped: that the art mostly shows everyday life such as hunting, with belief added in 'some' pictures. Hunting scenes are not common, animals (especially the eland) are among the most common subjects, and most researchers now read most of the art as being about belief. Dance is right: the healing or trance dance is a very common subject. Keep the dance, drop hunting as a main subject, name animals, and make belief the main meaning rather than an extra. In substance: many pictures show animals such as the eland, and people dancing, and researchers think much of the art has to do with what the people believed.
